IN-4.name: Drew Cox
IN-4.evidence: Candidate profile: Medicare for All, Ban Corporate PACs Act, refuses AIPAC money, Workplace Democracy Act, higher taxes on ultra-wealthy. Left-leaning platform but no Sanders/OR/WFP/JD backing found, and he is a longtime party precinct official, so liberal/mixed by the brief's rules.

MI-2.name: Ben Ambrose
MI-2.evidence: Marine veteran from a small farm; backs single-payer Medicare for All; says corporations and monopolies control prices; UFCW Local 951 endorsement. No Sanders/OR/WFP backing found.

NJ-4.name: Rachel Peace
NJ-4.evidence: Described as 'outsider candidate', 33-year-old single mother; universal coverage, overturn Citizens United, tax corporations/wealthy; but endorsed by Ocean and Monmouth County Democratic organizations and NJ Citizen Action PAC.

PA-17.name: Chris Deluzio
PA-17.evidence: Reelection launch: 'the American dream... for so many, now it's a myth', 'a complete failure from our government, both parties, for decades' - anti-establishment economic framing. CPC membership alone not left.

TX-30.name: Frederick Haynes III
TX-30.evidence: Called 'Texas' Newest Justice Democrat', one of 16 JD candidates; platform cracking down on corporate lobbying, banning congressional stock trading, predatory lending; framed as working people vs concentrated wealth. Outsider pastor in open seat.

TX-28.name: Henry Cuellar
TX-28.evidence: Texas Tribune: 'arguably the most conservative Democrat in the U.S. House', breaks with party on border, backs oil and gas, 'I run as a mayor' earmark-delivery incumbent; Blue Dog member (coded moderate per Blue Dog rule; could be argued conservative).

TN-9.name: Justin J. Pearson
TN-9.evidence: Justice Democrats-endorsed insurgent primary challenge to incumbent Steve Cohen; 'We can't afford more of the same'; Medicare for All; Leaders We Deserve $1M.

NY-10.name: Brad Lander
NY-10.evidence: Insurgent challenge to incumbent Dan Goldman (backed by Hochul/Jeffries); endorsed by Sanders ('take on the oligarchs'), Mamdani, Warren; WFP line. Longtime NYC comptroller, so mixed rather than outsider populist.

IL-13.name: Nikki Budzinski
IL-13.evidence: Incumbent framing: 'I've secured millions in investments', fighting Trump's attacks on healthcare, Democrats retaking majority. Labor background (memory) but conventional campaign.

WI-7.name: Fred Clark
WI-7.evidence: Self-described 'independent Democrat' willing to buck party, 'center path', 'positions that aren't always in the mainstream for my party'; rural, government for people not 'big corporations', no national party money.

WI-6.name: Brad Smith
WI-6.evidence: Political newcomer, National Guard veteran/small-business owner; Congress as 'tour of duty'; campaign reportedly takes no corporate PAC or AIPAC money (search snippet, wispolitics); WEAC/NEA endorsed. No explicit centrist branding.

FL-7.name: Bale Dalton
FL-7.evidence: Retired Navy captain, ex-NASA chief of staff; New Politics 'service-first leadership' endorsement; conventional platform (reverse Medicaid cuts, overturn Citizens United, tax cuts for working people not ultra-wealthy); Red to Blue-type recruit.

LA-1.name: Lauren Jewett
LA-1.evidence: Special-ed teacher/union member; 'Healthcare is a human right... Medicare for All long-term'; signed pledge to abolish ICE; corporations take profits. Left-leaning positions but no Sanders/OR/WFP/JD backing found.
